translated_title: Use of ‘Fracking’ to Obtain Gas Is Still Being Investigated; Energy Sovereignty Is Being Sought, Sheinbaum Says
original_title: Uso de 'fracking' para obtener gas aún se está investigando; se busca la soberanía energética: Sheinbaum
author: Fabiola Martínez and Alma E. Muñoz
meta_description: Sheinbaum casts unconventional gas as national security, but says no decision has been made yet. Texas already supplies 60 percent of Mexico's gas through fracking.
